text:
I've read every source file, the tests, the config/build scripts, and the committed demo outputs. Here's the honest assessment.

## Overall

The code itself is better than most "written a few months ago, never audited" repos: small focused modules, type hints throughout, deterministic seeding, `yaml.safe_load`, no real security surface, and a test suite that covers the math. But the repo has one disqualifying problem and a cluster of silent-fallback and methodological issues in the HuggingFace path.

**The blocker: the repo doesn't run.** `emovec/data.py:24-36` loads stories from `data/stories/`, and that directory doesn't exist anywhere in the repo. There's also no generation script, even though the README (line 11) says stories are "loaded or generated." The committed `outputs/tiny_demo/vectors/manifest.json` proves the data existed when the demo was last run — it was either never committed or deleted since. As a result, `make demo` and the integration test (`tests/test_integration_tiny.py:12`) both die immediately with `FileNotFoundError`, so the test suite is red as committed. (Note: I have no shell in this environment so I couldn't execute pytest, but the failure is unconditional from the code path.)

**The methodological caveat worth knowing before "active development":** the tiny backend is circular by construction. `extract.py:32` passes each story's ground-truth emotion label into the backend, and `model.py:147-148` adds `2.0 × emotion_vector` to the activations for that label. Extraction then "discovers" exactly what was injected, and the integration test asserts `diagonal_gt_off_diagonal is True` on that rigged signal. Fine as a deterministic smoke test, but it validates nothing about the method — and that's not documented anywhere.

**HF backend issues that would matter the day someone runs it on Gemma:** the logit lens (`model.py:252-260`) applies `lm_head` to the raw residual vector without the final layernorm and ignores Gemma-2's logit softcapping, so the token rankings are not a faithful lens; the preference probe (`model.py:306-308`) prompts for "a preference score:" but then measures ` good` vs ` bad` first-token logits — a prompt/measurement mismatch, with multi-token encodings silently truncated; and if offset mapping is unavailable (`model.py:239-240`), steering silently applies to *every* token instead of just the activity tokens.

## Issue list

| # | Location | Sev | Description |
|---|----------|-----|-------------|
| 1 | `emovec/data.py:24-36` | high | `data/stories/` is missing from the repo and there's no generation script — extraction is unrunnable |
| 2 | `tests/test_integration_tiny.py:12-28` | high | Integration test fails with `FileNotFoundError` due to issue 1; suite is red as committed |
| 3 | `emovec/extract.py:32`, `emovec/model.py:147-148` | medium | Tiny backend injects the ground-truth label into activations, making extraction/validation circular and the test assertion vacuous |
| 4 | `emovec/model.py:252-260` | medium | Logit lens skips the final layernorm and Gemma-2 logit softcapping — misleading token rankings |
| 5 | `emovec/model.py:306-308` | medium | Prompt asks for a "preference score" but code measures ` good`/` bad` logits; multi-token encodings truncated to `[0]` |
| 6 | `emovec/model.py:239-240` | medium | With no offset mapping, steering silently falls back to all token positions instead of the activity span |
| 7 | `emovec/validate_contexts.py:66` | medium | If "afraid" isn't in the emotion set, emotion index 0 is silently used while outputs stay labeled "afraid" |
| 8 | `emovec/extract.py:15-20,34` | low | Token-start fallback logic duplicated in two places; manifest values computed separately from values actually used |
| 9 | `emovec/extract.py:41-45` | low | Neutral PCA uses all token positions while emotion means start at `token_start` — inconsistent preprocessing |
| 10 | `emovec/steer_prefs.py:45-49` | low | When fewer than 4 emotions are selected, correlation-based picks are discarded wholesale rather than topped up |
| 11 | `config.yaml:50` | low | `steering.min_reported_emotions` is never read by any code |
| 12 | `emovec/elo.py:22-29` | low | Elo ratings are path-dependent on fixed pair order and round count; undocumented |
| 13 | `emovec/elo.py:18-19` | low | Magic temperature constant `20.0` in pairwise probability, unconfigurable and uncommented |
| 14 | `emovec/model.py:246` | low | No `truncation`/`max_length` on tokenization; long stories can exceed Gemma's context |
| 15 | repo root | low | No LICENSE file |

## Lines to rewrite

The package is roughly 1,000 lines of Python. Restoring or generating the story dataset (~100 new lines for a generator script), fixing the HF logit lens and preference probe (~30), removing the silent fallbacks (~20), deduplicating the token-start logic and aligning the PCA preprocessing (~15), and cleaning up the steering selection and dead config (~15) puts the estimate at **~180 lines** changed or added. The core math in `vector_ops.py` and `artifacts.py` is solid and needs nothing.

## Bottom line

**No, I would not approve this as-is.** Not because the code is sloppy — it isn't — but because the repo cannot execute its own README instructions and its own test suite fails out of the box. Restore the data (or add the generator), document the tiny backend's circularity, and fix the three HF-path correctness issues, and this becomes approvable quickly.
